Georgetown Writing Supplement

Georgetown requires submission of two short essays and two long essays:

Short Essay 1: Briefly discuss the significance to you of the school or summer activity in which you have been most involved. (250 Words)

Short Essay 2: In all our lives, we interact with people who hold different viewpoints than our own. Describe such an event you experienced. What did you learn from the experience? (250 Words)

Essay 1: As Georgetown is a diverse community, the Admissions Committee would like to know more about you in your own words. Please submit a brief personal or creative essay which you feel best describes you. (650 Words)

If you believe that your Common App personal statement would fit with this prompt, you are welcome to use it here.

Essay 2: School Specific Essay Prompt (500 Words)

For Applicants to the College of Arts & Sciences: The College is committed to an integrated education. Describe your interest in studying in the College of Arts & Sciences.

For Applicants to the Berkley School of Nursing: Describe the factors that have influenced your interest in studying Nursing at Georgetown University.

Applicants to the School of Health: Describe the factors that influenced your interest in studying health care at Georgetown University.
